auto_scale_period.description: Length in seconds of the time window for average calculation.

in_max_scaling.description: Specifies the 100% mark in kBit/s of the graph indicating incoming bandwidth usage.

out_max_scaling.description: Specifies the 100% mark in kBit/s of the graph indicating outgoing bandwidth usage.

refresh_interval.description: Refresh interval of the display in milliseconds.

traffic_unit.description: Unit type used for the display of traffic numbers (bits/seconds).

traffic_data_unit.description: Unit type used for the display of total amount of data.

devices.description: List of network devices to monitor. If empty, all auto-detected devices are used.
